analyst_view.overall: Fiorentina are 16th with 8 points and have only 2 points from five home games; Paolo Vanoli has been brought back to steady them, and they won 4-2 at Sassuolo last time out. Juventus are seventh after beating AZ 2-1 in the Europa League on Thursday, with Luciano Spalletti under pressure and a long injury list (Yildiz, Thuram, Conceição, Locatelli, Nico González and others). Fiorentina are missing Parisi, Atta and Pongračić, and Ranieri is being assessed.

goals.text: The numbers say 2.4 goals. Fiorentina may be down to two senior centre-backs if Ranieri misses out, which helps Juventus, but Juventus are without Yildiz, Conceição and Nico González and played on Thursday. These point in opposite directions, so we stay with the site.

corners.text: The numbers say 9.7 corners. Both teams have been inconsistent and we found nothing about a change of approach from Vanoli or Spalletti, so we keep the site's figure.

cards.text: The numbers say 6.4 cards, pushed up 39% by treating this as a derby plus the referee's record. It is a bitter rivalry, but that derby boost is very large, and we found no pre-match flashpoint or suspension story this week. We lean slightly below the site's number.

shots.text: The numbers say 27.5 shots, raised by Fiorentina's recent games. Spalletti may rotate after Thursday's Europa League game, but Fiorentina need a home result, so the two roughly balance.

shots_on_target.text: The numbers say 8.1 shots on target. Juventus's injury list takes away creators like Yildiz and Conceição, but Fiorentina's defence is thin, so we keep the site's figure.
